verdict.rationale: Codex's own docs say cloud tasks can be started from GitHub pull requests, GitLab merge requests and issues, Linear issues, and Slack channels and threads, which covers all four platforms named in the story. The evidence is brief marketing-level documentation only. Missing for 10: in-depth setup or integration docs for each platform, independent or hands-on corroboration that triggering from these tools works.

support.subject: As a developer, I can kick off agent tasks directly from GitHub, GitLab, Linear, or Slack

citations.quote: Start work in Codex cloud from GitHub pull requests, GitLab merge requests and issues, Linear issues, or Slack channels and threads.
